name: Semantic Pseudo Label with Global Structure Prior
aliases: Semantic Pseudo Label with Global Structure Prior — DINO-ViT CLS Token Loss
definition: A global structure prior using a pre-trained Vision Transformer (ViT) to enforce semantic consistency between unseen views and the reference view, robust to pixel-wise misalignment.
summary: Semantic Pseudo Label with Global Structure Prior enforces semantic consistency in radiance field optimization by using a DINO-ViT CLS token as a global prior, making it robust to pixel-wise misalignment unlike methods relying on pixel-wise alignment.
